title: Seconds lived over a number of years
description: Write a function `seconds_lived(years)` that returns how many seconds a person lives in `years` years, assuming 365 days per year.
hints: Idea to consider: build the conversion from smaller units up
A year has 365 days, a day has 24 hours, an hour has 3600 seconds - multiplying years by each of those in turn converts all the way down to seconds.
expected_behavior: Returns the total number of seconds in the given number of years (365-day years).
explanation: Unit conversions chain by multiplication - years to days, days to hours, hours to minutes, minutes to seconds - each factor is just the count of the smaller unit inside the larger one.
